confidence_notes: Crowd-sourced city price data supports the meal, coffee and beer estimates; cocktail and wine prices are inferred from their relationship to local beer. Accommodation is estimated from the supplied peer-city prices, without live listing checks.
comparable_city_reasoning: Luang Prabang’s stronger visitor demand suggests prices somewhat above Vientiane and Vang Vieng: estimated three-star rooms at $38 versus their $34 and $25, and basic rooms at $25 versus $22 and $14. Dorm and private-room estimates are also slightly higher than the supplied Laos comparables.
